card.name: Closing bracket in 2-ethylhexyl phthalates
card.fires_on: Mostly the closing parenthesis right after "2-ethylhexyl" in plasticizer names such as DEHP and TOTM. Weaker hits fall on scattered spots in dose tables and on "of" before bupivacaine.

modes.label: Plasticizer name bracket
modes.description: The closing parenthesis after 2-ethylhexyl, just before phthalate or trimellitate.

modes.label: Dose table and label scraps
modes.description: Scattered spots in anesthetic dose tables or before bupivacaine, such as a space inside a range or the word "of".
modes.example: RISK OF CARDIAC ARREST WITH USE<< OF>> BUPIVACAINE HYDRO

card.plain: It fires on the closing bracket in the plastic additive name di(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate, and weakly on bits of anesthetic dose tables.
